scope: Keep the existing INTA architecture organized while expanding every current service area.

decisions.reason: The eight existing service groups already cover all22 jobs; one source can generate app and Wiki navigation without new competing categories.
Use short problem-specific cases inside existing jobs, with reference/tool details linked separately; preserve the complete existing guides.

decisions.candidate: Replace the current static builder with another documentation platform
decisions.reason: No unmet organization requirement needs a framework migration. The current single-file offline app, exact acquisitions, saved state and stable Wiki routes are valuable working behavior.

decisions.candidate: GitHub Actions schedule for editorial-age reporting
decisions.reason: Run read-only structure and due-date reporting on weekdays; preserve full results without changing content or review dates. Scheduled execution is best effort, separate from the maintenance task.

limits: Editorial architecture choices, not a comparative runtime benchmark or proof of tool operation on client hardware.
